themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including research operations, automated research, and AI co-scientists.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, or understanding code, including AI code generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles covering a broad range of AI-powered tools specifically designed to aid in various research processes, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: This theme focuses on research and studies concerning the behavior, accuracy, and impact of AI chatbots on users and information consumption.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into shorter, more digestible summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content exploring how AI is changing jobs, skills, recruitment processes, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial or simulated user profiles for testing, research, or data generation.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being applied to enhance or transform the practices of UX and design research.

themes.name: AI for product research
themes.description: Articles exploring the application of AI in understanding market needs, user behavior, and informing product development decisions.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content related to the use of AI to automate or augment usability testing processes and analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
